disclaimer.title: Important
disclaimer.text: Unofficial auxiliary service. Data comes from manual text reports by volunteer spotters — district-level accuracy, seconds-to-minutes delay. It does NOT replace the official air-raid alert. Always act on the siren and official apps.
disclaimer.never: No target on the map, or a vector 'not heading your way', is NOT a reason to ignore the alert.

notice.clearBody: The threat to {{where}} has passed. The air-raid alert is over — {{tail}}
notice.clearTail2: the threat is no longer being tracked.
notice.clearTail3: the sky over the city is clear.

settings.title: Settings
settings.feedRegionPending: No data yet — the region is declared, coverage is being prepared

game.settingsHint: Experimental. Collectible cards after analysing targets — a small way to cope with the fear during raids. Does not affect the map, alerts or threats.
game.safetyConfirm: Are you sure you're in a safe place? This is a way to distract yourself a little during a raid — never a reason to leave shelter or take your attention off your own safety.
game.takenBody: Someone else already analysed this target.
game.errorBody: Could not finish the analysis. Please try again.

notify.title: Danger notifications
notify.needHome: Set “My home” first — notifications are tied to your home zone.
notify.denied: Notifications are blocked in the browser — allow them in the site settings.
notify.iosInstallFirst: On iPhone notifications only work from the installed app (iOS 16.4+) — add it to the Home Screen first.
notify.policy: Supplementary alerts from volunteer data: a target near your home zone or on a course toward it. Never a replacement for the official air-raid alert.

levelHint.danger: Only when a target is already near your home zone

prefs.citywideHint: A target on Kyiv with no district fix — once per attack wave

home.title: My home
home.hint: Click on the map to set home
home.geoDenied: Geolocation denied — set home by clicking the map
home.geoImplausible: That fix looks jammed — the coordinates fall outside every watched region. Set your home manually.
home.searchPlaceholder: Find an address or a locality
home.approxHint: Approximate — measured from the centre of the district where the target was seen
home.markerPreviewHint: This is how your marker looks on the map

nudge.title: Mark your home
nudge.distance: Distance and bearing to every target — from your home, not the city centre
nudge.notify: Notifications only when a threat is close to you
nudge.framing: The map opens on your own area

friends.shareHomeHint: Contacts will see your home on the map
friends.removeConfirm: Remove {{name}} from contacts? You'll no longer see each other's home on the map.

error.notFound: No user found with that email

bug.title: Report a bug
bug.intro: Describe what went wrong: what you saw and what you expected.
bug.placeholder: For example: after opening settings the map shrank into the corner
bug.pasteHint: or paste one from the clipboard (Ctrl+V)
bug.sent: Thank you — the report was sent.
bug.needAuth: Sign in to send a report — otherwise there's nobody to ask for details.
bug.failed: Could not send. Please try again
bug.rateLimited: Too many reports in a row — try again a bit later
bug.needSomething: Describe the problem or attach a screenshot

journal.title: Air threat journal
journal.subtitle: Daily activity: attacks, targets, types and alert duration
journal.pickDay: Pick a day on the calendar

stats.subtitle: Period at a glance: when alerts happen, what flies and where
stats.underAlert: that is {{percent}} of the time under alert
stats.hourAlertShare: Chance of an alert by hour
stats.hourNote: Hours are Kyiv time. The top chart is the share of that hour spent under alert; the bottom one is how many targets were first sighted in it.
stats.alertWindowNote: Alerts are counted from {{from}} — when the official alert channel was added, so earlier days don't dilute the percentages.
stats.districtNote: Ranked by the number of days a target was seen over the district. The report count tracks how busy the spotters were that night.

regionGate.title: The journal covers {{region}}
regionGate.subtitle: Figures for {{region}} — not for your region
regionGate.body: You follow a different oblast. The targets, raions and alerts here are {{region}}'s — yours are not in these numbers. The data is real, it is just not about you.

presence.shareLabel: Show when I was last online
presence.shareHint: Friends always see that you're online. This adds your last-active time when you're away.

avatar.title: Avatar
avatar.removeConfirm: Remove your avatar? A monogram will be shown instead.

marker.contactPreviewHint: This is how this contact's marker looks on your map

speed.approxHint: Typical speed for this target class, not a measurement
speed.etaHint: Estimated from the class speed and the distance to the district centre

currentRegion.title: My oblast
currentRegion.hint: Which targets reach the feed, what the map opens on, and what may notify you. Where exactly you live is separate — the home marker above.

regionPicker.title: Which oblast are you in?
regionPicker.text: It decides which targets reach your feed, what the map opens on, and what may notify you. Changeable any time in settings.
